faq: What is the difference between a role and a permission?
A permission is a single allowed action, like deleting a project. A role is a named bundle of permissions, like admin. People get roles, so one change updates many rules.
Can I use a library or service for this?
Yes. Tools like Casbin, CASL or your auth provider's roles can help. We pick what fits your stack, and explain the choice so your developers are comfortable with it.
Can you add roles to an app that has none?
Yes. We start by giving every current user a sensible default role, so nothing breaks, then add the new rules step by step and test each one.
How do I know nothing is missed?
We list every action and screen, test each role against the list and share the results. No one can promise zero gaps, but a written check makes the gaps visible.
